answer_1.quote: AMR-to-text generates sentences representing the semantics underlying an AMR graph.

answer_2.quote: We considered the three automatic evaluation metrics commonly used in previous works. We compute BLEU using SacreBLEU. We compute chrF++ using both SacreBLEU and the scripts used by authors of the baseline systems. We compute METEOR with the default values for English of the CMU implementation.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations are carried out by three professional annotators on 51 randomly selected sentences from the 1371 test sentences, on a 6 point scale, ranging from 0 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: A 6-point scale assessing grammar, vocabulary, style, and clarity of meaning.
